basic_details.job_title: HCI Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 3 Junior Sous Chef, Commis-I Posts
basic_details.short_information: Hotel Corporation of India Ltd. (HCI), a subsidiary of AIAHL, will hold a Trade Test and Walk-in Interview on 1 December 2026 for all three posts, with reporting between 9.00 AM and 12.30 PM. The venue is Hotel Corporation of India Ltd., The Centaur Hotel, Near IGI Airport, Terminal-3, New Delhi – 110037. The posts are Junior Sous Chef (Rs 47,500/-), Commis-I (Indian) and Commis-I (Bakery & Confectionery) (Rs. 35,000/- each), one vacancy each on a fixed-term contract, open to eligible Indian citizens.

content_sections.heading: About HCI
content_sections.text: Hotel Corporation of India Limited (HCI) is a subsidiary of AIAHL. According to the notice, HCI operates The Centaur Hotel, New Delhi and Chefair Mumbai. The posts in this notice are marked CHDA, which the notice explains as Centaur Hotel Delhi Airport.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The vacancy table shows 3 posts in total, all in the GEN column; the SC, ST, OBC and EWS columns are blank. Eligibility is counted as on 01-10-2026. The pay is the consolidated cost to company (CTC). Experience: a minimum of 4 years in the hospitality industry/ flight kitchen/ institutional catering/ cloud kitchen, OR minimum 10+2 with a certification in culinary arts and a minimum of 5 years in the food production department of a major chain of hotels/ hotel of repute. Should have knowledge of Continental, Indian Curry & Tandoor. Preferred: a Degree or Diploma in Hotel Management, Culinary Arts or Food Production from a recognized Institute; knowledge of Basic Computer skills including MS Office. Upper age limit: 50 years. Experience: a minimum of 2 years in the hospitality industry/ flight kitchen/ institutional catering/ cloud kitchen, OR minimum 10+2 with a certification in culinary arts and a minimum of 5 years in the Baker & Confectioner/ Food Production Department of a major chain of hotels / hotel of repute. Upper age limit: 45 years. Experience: a minimum of 2 years in the hospitality industry/ flight kitchen/ institutional catering/ cloud kitchen, OR minimum 10+2 with a certification in culinary arts and a minimum of 5 years in the Food Production department of a major chain of hotels / hotel of repute. Should have knowledge of Continental & Indian Curry. Upper age limit: 45 years. The upper age limit is relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST and 3 years for OBC candidates. Ex-Servicemen get age relaxation as per rules. Candidates claiming relaxation must produce the original certificate issued by the appropriate authority for Central Government employment. The notice prints the form's age field as on 01.10.2026. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility details of each post.

content_sections.heading: HCI Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Reports to the Executive Chef. Responsible for preparing the dishes as per laid-out SOPs and on a timely basis as per the day's schedule and menu. Reports to the Sous Chef. The notice says reporting executives may be changed at the discretion of the management at any time without assigning any reasons.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Candidates bring the Application Form complete in all aspects (the prescribed format is on pages 4 to 6 of the notice), together with the following: A recent passport size photograph pasted in the space provided in the Application Form. Original and one set of self-attested documents for date of birth. Original and one set of self-attested documents for Educational Qualification and Professional Qualification. Experience Certificate, or the Appointment Letter and Relieving Letter/Full & Final Clearance Letter, from all previous employers. For the Reserved Category vacancy: the appropriate certificate in the prescribed proforma issued by the appropriate authority for Central Government employment. For applicants serving in Government/ Semi-Government/ Public Sector Undertakings or Autonomous bodies: the application routed through proper channel, or a "No Objection Certificate" from the present employer. The Application Form asks for personal details, reference-check particulars of referring managers for up to three organisations, educational and professional qualifications from 10+2 onwards, positions held, any departmental enquiry or penalty in the last 5 years, and whether the candidate is related to any past or present HCI employee. The candidate also declares that HCI may conduct reference checks at any stage.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: All three posts have the same schedule: Trade Test & Walk-in Interview on 01/12/2026, with reporting between 9.00 AM and 12.30 PM. Those provisionally eligible will be allowed to appear for an Interview. Candidates who do not fulfil all the criteria, or cannot show the supporting documents in original, will not be allowed to appear for the personal interview and their candidature shall be disqualified. Applications received incomplete, mutilated or without any of the supporting documents will be rejected. If no candidate is found suitable for these positions, HCI will issue a corrigendum on its websites.

content_sections.heading: Terms of the Job
content_sections.text: Contract: Fixed Term Employment Contract of 03 (Three) years, extendable by another (02) years based on annual performance. The tenure can be extended or curtailed as per the Company's requirement, and the contract may be terminated at the discretion of the management without assigning any reason and/or in the event of unsatisfactory performance. Pay: the consolidated CTC shown above during the 3-year period; based on consistent exceptional performance, extension of services and CTC will be reviewed every year. Place of work: based in Delhi, which can be changed depending on the requirement of the Company. Entitlements: free meals on duty and staff discounts as per prevailing rules of the company, and reimbursement of approved local and outstation official travel expenses.

faq.question: Q1. When is the HCI walk-in interview 2026?
faq.answer: The Trade Test and Walk-in Interview for all three posts is on 01/12/2026 (1 December 2026).

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time for the HCI walk-in?
faq.answer: Reporting for all the posts is between 9.00 AM and 12.30 PM at the venue.

faq.question: Q3. Where is the HCI walk-in venue?
faq.answer: The venue is Hotel Corporation of India Ltd., The Centaur Hotel, Near IGI Airport, Terminal-3, New Delhi – 110037.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are there in HCI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: one each for Junior Sous Chef, Commis-I (Indian) and Commis-I (Bakery & Confectionery), all in the GEN column. The number is indicative and subject to change as per business requirements.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification for Junior Sous Chef?
faq.answer: Graduate with a certification in Food Production, plus a minimum of 4 years' experience in the hospitality industry/ flight kitchen/ institutional catering/ cloud kitchen, OR minimum 10+2 with a certification in culinary arts and a minimum of 5 years' experience in the food production department of a major chain of hotels/ hotel of repute.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 50 years for Junior Sous Chef and 45 years for the two Commis-I posts, relaxable by 5 years for SC/ST and 3 years for OBC.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for HCI Junior Sous Chef and Commis-I?
faq.answer: The consolidated cost to company is Rs 47,500/- for Junior Sous Chef and Rs. 35,000/- for each Commis-I post.

faq.question: Q8. Is the HCI job permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is a Fixed Term Employment Contract of 03 (Three) years, extendable by another (02) years based on annual performance. The candidate cannot claim permanent absorption.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I bring to the HCI walk-in?
faq.answer: Bring the completed Application Form with a pasted passport size photograph, plus originals and one self-attested set of documents for date of birth, qualifications and experience, and a category certificate or No Objection Certificate where applicable.

faq.question: Q10. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Selection for all three posts is by Trade Test and Walk-in Interview on 01/12/2026. Selected candidates must also undergo a Pre-Employment Medical Examination.
